node.name: More_like_'Sleepius'_lmao
node.description: Bring 100 kebabs from the Town Shop, and 50 Crabby Cakey from defeating crabcakes.

item:Timecandy2.name: 2_HR_Time_Candy
item:Timecandy2.description: Hold down to instantly get 2 Hour of AFK Gains.

item:ResetCompleted.name: Talent_Point_Reset_Potion
item:ResetCompleted.description: Hold down on this item to respec all your Talent Points! Well, except for the Star tab points, there's a different potion for that.

item:ResetFrag.name: Talent_Point_Reset_Fragment
item:ResetFrag.description: Hold down on this item to turn 10 Fragments into 1 Talent Point Reset Potion. You'll need 1 open inventory space for this to work.

item:FoodHealth6.name: Kebab_Sticks
item:FoodHealth6.description: Auto-Used when your health goes below 50%. Restores 300 HP. Has a 30 second Cooldown.

item:DesertA3.name: Crabby_Cakey
item:DesertA3.description: You could probably start a restaurant selling these! Just employ an overeager cook, give the place a cool name like The Crispy Crustacean, and you'd be set!

quest:Speccius1.description: Bring 100 kebabs from the Town Shop, and 50 Crabby Cakey from defeating crabcakes.

pageProps.seoDescription: More like 'Sleepius' lmao is a Legends of Idleon quest: 3 rewards. Bring 100 kebabs from the Town Shop, and 50 Crabby Cakey from defeating crabcakes.
